messages:
emily: quick noteabout the canary this morning: two tenants failed deploys when they used an unknown value for `pin_behavior`.

ben: saw it, we rolled back. control-plane schema rejects unknown enum values right now.

luca: runtime tolerated it (treated as no-op) but routing layer didn't, so mismatch caused traffic differences.

marta: proposal: introduce per-field metadata -> impact: routing|telemetry|fallback + validation: strict|warn|ignore. default validation=warn.

raj: agree default warn. routing-impacting fields must be opt-in; otherwise silent behavior change is unacceptable.

ana: (telemetry) add metric `rollout.metadata.unknown_fields_total` with tenant+field tags so we can track plateaus.

emily: plan: switch control-plane to WARN for unknown enums for 14 days, publish schema_version top-level and enum mapping docs, then settle to IGNORE for non-routing fields.

ben: I'll flip the validator to warn for canary and add a grafana panel.

luca: I'll make runtime treat unknown routing fields as explicit no-op unless tenant opts in via API.

marta: owners set. quick sync Thurs 10. If no objections by EOD we ship the warn window.
